integrity: The formulas are proved by finite marked-tree bijections and asymptotic moments. 631 exact checker assertions are supplementary, not a proof of all-size or external certification. Historical priority is qualified.
scientific_limitations: Uniform labeled unrooted Cayley tree model only; no joint CLT or extension to binary ranked trees. Exact first-public date of Erdős–Rényi (1963) could not be verified beyond September 1963; the 2011-12-06 anchor is the earliest securely day-dated electronic primary source inspected, not the earliest relevant scientific work.
title: Cherry-Palm deletion and persistent leaf–symmetry correlation in uniform Cayley trees
